contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A base sherd fragment from a Roman Gaulish Lezoux samian ware vessel dating to AD 150-185. The sherd consists of part of the floor of the vessel with makers stamp. The fabric is a buff orange colour and is fully oxidised. It is hard and exhibits frequent micaceous inclusions. The vessel has been coated in a dark orange slip which has been abraded in places.
